user.title: Connect HAIGS to an instance
user.description: Address of the instance and its provider. "auto" asks the instance itself (two or three small requests) and is right for gitlab.com, codeberg.org, gitea.com, and self-hosted servers alike; pick a named provider if auto-detection cannot decide. The host is enough; a pasted link is shortened to it. Public instances work without a token, private ones usually need a read token.

error.anbieter_unerkannt: No GitLab, Gitea, or Forgejo answered there — pick the provider by hand — {grund}

abort.already_configured: This instance is already set up

create_entry.verbunden: Connected to {host} ({anbieter}) — {anzahl} projects carry the topic hacs

repository.title: Add a custom repository
repository.description: Full address of the project, e.g. https://{host}/group/project. The topic hacs is not required -- it only matters for discovery.

data.dateien_deinstallieren: Also remove installed files (from stage M4)

katalog.title: Official HACS repositories
katalog.description: Shows the repositories of the official HACS catalog (integrations, plugins, themes) in the HAIGS store, so a single store in the sidebar is enough. No token needed; the catalog is read from data-v2.hacs.xyz. The developer mode does not apply to it.

entwickler.title: Developer mode
entwickler.description: Instead of releases, HAIGS installs the latest state of each repository's default branch – every push is downloadable right away. Versions then look like main@1a2b3c4. Meant for testing your own work; switch it off again for daily use.

data.entwicklermodus: Load the default branch instead of releases

error.anderer_host: This entry watches {eigener}; the address points to {host}. Set up that instance as its own entry.
error.nicht_bereit: The integration is not ready; try again shortly

abort.liste_leer: No repositories are being watched yet
abort.katalog_entfernt: The HACS catalog entry was removed.

token_problem.title: The token of {host} no longer works
token_problem.description: The last update runs failed with an authorization error. Check the token of this GitLab instance; HAIGS retries on its own and clears this message when it succeeds again.

repo_verschwunden.title: Repository disappeared: {name}
repo_verschwunden.description: The GitLab reports this repository as gone. Reason: {grund}. Remove it from the list, or restore the project.

repo_krank.title: Repository reports errors: {name}
repo_krank.description: The update check keeps failing for this repository. Reason: {grund}. Other repositories are unaffected.

kategorie_gendert.title: Category no longer matches: {name}
kategorie_gendert.description: The owner labeled this repository as "{neue}" (hacs-{neue} topic), but it is registered here as "{alte}". Check which one is intended; this message clears once the topic and the registered category agree again.

ablage_unlesbar.title: Unreadable entries in the storage of {host}
ablage_unlesbar.description: {anzahl} stored entries could not be read and were skipped. Nothing was deleted. The next time the list is saved, only readable entries are written; this message disappears after a restart once the storage is clean.

neustart_nach_installation.title: Restart required: {name}
neustart_nach_installation.description: {aktion} of version {version} is in place as files — but Home Assistant loads integrations only at startup. A restart makes the change take effect; this hint then clears itself.
